title: Ashes
text:
We have spoken words,

words to wake the dead,

words to make a fire,

words where we could sit down

and smile.

We have created the sermon

of bird and sea,

the sermon of water,

the sermon of love.

We have knelt

and adored vast phrases

like the sigh of the star,

phrases like waves,

phrases with wings.

We have invented new names

for wine and for laughter,

for gazes and their terrible

paths.

I now am alone

-like the delirious miser

on her mountain of gold-

throwing words toward the sky,

but I am alone

and cannot tell my beloved

those words by which I live.
editorial_note: The translation keeps the communal we giving way to the solitary I at the end.

title: Before the Lugubrious Mania of Living...
text:
Before the lugubrious mania of living

this hidden joke of living

drags you along Alejandra do not deny it.


today you looked at yourself in the mirror

and you left sad you were alone

and the light roared the air sang

but your beloved did not return


you will send messages you will smile

you will wave your hands so he will return

your beloved so beloved


you hear the mad siren that stole him

the ship with beards of foam

where laughter died

you remember the last embrace

oh no anguish

laugh into the handkerchief cry with guffaws

but close the doors of your face

so they will not say later

that that woman in love was you


the days gnaw at you

the nights blame you

life hurts you so so much

desperate where are you going?

desperate nothing more!
editorial_note: The translation keeps the rush of address and sparse punctuation that make the self-rebuke feel breathless.

title: The Night
text:
Little do I know of the night

but the night seems to know of me,

and more still, assists me as if it loved me,

covers my consciousness with its stars.

Perhaps night is life and the sun death.

Perhaps night is nothing

and conjectures about it nothing

and the beings who live it nothing.

Perhaps words are the only thing that exists

in the enormous void of the centuries

that scratch our soul with their memories.

But night must know the misery

that drinks from our blood and from our ideas.

It must throw hatred at our gazes

knowing them full of interests, of missed encounters.

But it happens that I hear the night crying in my bones.

Its immense tear raves

and screams that something went away forever.

Someday we shall be again.
editorial_note: The translation lets night remain both cosmic and intimate, with raves carrying the delirious force of delira.

title: My Love Expands...
text:
My love expands.

It is a perfect parachute.

It is a click that is exhaled and

its chest becomes immense.

My love does not roar

does not cry out

does not plead

does not laugh.

Its body is an eye.

Its skin is a world map.

My words pierce

the last sign of its name.

My kisses are eels that he

prides himself on letting slip.

My caresses a reminiscent jet

of music over fountains of Rome.

No one has yet been able to flee from his psychic territory.

There are no routes nor folds nor insects.

Everything is so smooth

that my tears revolt.

My creation is prudery

beside his blond cart.

At these moments the inkwell takes flight

and heads toward endless borders

of mosquitoes making love.

The fatal sound rings out.

I no longer fly.

It is my love that expands.
editorial_note: The surreal catalog is kept literal, including the world map, eels, and airborne inkwell.

title: Night
text:
Perhaps this night is not night,

it must be a horrendous sun, or

the other thing, or anything.

What do I know! Words are lacking,

candor is lacking, poetry is lacking

when blood cries and cries!


I could be so happy tonight!

If only it were given me to touch

the shadows, hear footsteps,

say "good evening" to anyone

walking their dog,

I would look at the moon, would say its

strange lactescence I would stumble

over random stones, as one does.


But there is something that breaks the skin,

a blind fury

that runs through my veins.

I want to go out! Cerberus of the soul.

Let, let me cross your smile!

I could be so happy tonight!


There are still belated dreams left.

And so many books! And so many lights!

And my few years! Why not?

Death is far away. It does not look at me.

So much life, Lord!

Why so much life?
editorial_note: The translation keeps the swing between ordinary nighttime wishes and mythic inner confinement.

title: Awaiting Darkness
text:
That unforgettable instant

So empty returned by shadows

So empty rejected by clocks

That poor instant adopted by my tenderness

Naked naked of blood of wings

Without eyes to remember anxieties of old

Without lips to gather the juice of violences

lost in the song of the frozen bell towers.


Shelter it blind girl of soul

Put on it your hair frosted by fire

Embrace it little statue of terror.

Point out to it the convulsed world at your feet

At your feet where swallows die

Shivering with dread before the future

Tell it that the sighs of the sea

Moisten the only words

for which it is worth living.


But that sweaty instant of nothing

Crouched in the cave of destiny

Without hands to say never

Without hands to give butterflies

To dead children.
editorial_note: The translation preserves the capitalized, breathless sequence of imperatives and absences.

title: Water Clock
text:
In the drop of water

blinks

the immutable needle

of time

and of no-time.


Like bone in flesh,

the sun is inside the suspended drop.


Interior insolation of time.


From

"Of Water, Fire and Other Purifications"

Ed. El Bardo, 1983, Barcelona
editorial_note: The translation keeps the compact visual movement and the bibliographic note from the source.

title: To Miss Matilde R.
text:
Flee the golden gate

of an existence you ignore,

for in this Eden you already adore,

it does not wake among lilies.

If in your candid delirium

our existence pleases you,

may your innocence never know

that this life is... martyrdom.
editorial_note: The translation keeps the direct counsel to innocence and the closing ellipsis before martyrdom.

title: Your Eyes Looked at Me...
text:
Your eyes looked at me

and in a beautiful east,

showed me a star

resplendent.

Your beautiful lip repaid

my submissive love,

and the star was a gleam

of paradise.


But in vain you kindled

my pleasant longing,

and brought down to earth

the light of heaven,

if soon you have extinguished

my beloved sun

and in shadows has left me

your frozen oblivion.
editorial_note: The translation preserves the songlike quatrain movement and the final darkening of the beloved sun.
